# Now 2.13.86
- Fixed cover art sometimes staying blank for a whole song while the title and artist showed correctly. A slow cover download was being restarted every second instead of being left to finish.

# Now 2.13.85
- Fixed the lyrics jumping back a couple of lines on the first pause of a song when playing through the Spotify desktop app. Position samples could be applied out of order. The first Apple Event to Spotify after it has been idle takes about two seconds, while later ones take five milliseconds, and pausing fires three follow-up reads in quick succession — so several requests were in flight at once and a slow early one could return after a fast later one, moving playback position backwards by seconds. Samples that describe an older moment than the one already applied are now discarded. Web players were unaffected because their bridge already collapses overlapping reads into a single request.

# Now 2.13.84
- Fixed the remaining lyric jump on pause: the once-per-song one, on the first pause after a song starts. Pausing a web player takes an AppleScript round trip, and the lyric clock kept running across it — so by the time the real paused position arrived, the clock had overshot it and had to correct backwards, pulling the highlighted line back a line or two. The first pause after a track change was the visible one because it also pays for browser tab discovery, making it by far the slowest. The clock now stops the instant you ask for a pause rather than when the player confirms, so it stops a fraction early and the correction that follows is forwards, which never jumps. The progress bar stops immediately too.
